title: Into the basket? Clip in now
lines: Stepped into the basket? First thing: clip in your harness.
To the anchor point, before the basket moves.
Even if the job is short and quick.
A sudden jolt doesn't give a warning.
Clip in first, then get to work.
A one-second habit that protects you for life.
Tal's daily tip. Ofek At Tal Cranes.
